research.finding: Closing a non-persistent context closes all of its pages. Terminal owned context disposal can replace a standalone tab-close operation; retained contexts require separate handling.

The non-proper termination wording corresponds to GNUTLS_E_PREMATURE_TERMINATION (-110), distinct from certificate validation errors. The owned endpoint reproduced the exact runtime message with certificate verification enabled.
